title: Token-wise logical SSM experts from one shared transition
hypothesis: For four stable 8D SSM transitions that switch roles every token, a shared transition plus per-role Givens codes achieves sequence NRMSE within 10% of independent experts at <=60% actual serialized bytes and no more than 1.5x recurrent inference wall time.
physical_object: one shared 8x8 recurrent state transition A plus shared input map B
mirror_coordinate: four per-role Givens angles acting on four state-coordinate planes
logical_multiplicity: four expert-like recurrent state transitions selected per token

task.teacher: four stable transition matrices generated by conjugating one base matrix with role-specific four-plane Givens rotations

success_gate: On each fresh world, Mirror sequence NRMSE <=1.1x independent, actual bytes <=60% independent, inference wall time <=1.5x independent, and same 32-token role sequence.
failure_gate: Mirror misses quality or byte threshold, or simple tying/rank-one dominates its frontier.
boundaries: Known oracle role labels; routing cost/quality not tested.
Synthetic 8D recurrence only; no Mamba language-model claim.
Measured CPU wall time is implementation-specific; no fused SSM kernel used.
